questions.statement: It is ________ today. I need my umbrella.
questions.context: Learning about weather and seasons in English class.

options.feedback: Rain is falling when you need an umbrella, so the day is rainy.
Sunny means the sun is shining, so you would not need an umbrella.
In windy weather the umbrella helps against the wind, not against rain.
Dry weather means there is no water at all, so no umbrella is needed.

options.feedback: 'Clear' describes the sky with no wind; the stem already tells us the wind is blowing.
Wind is blowing, so the weather is windy.
'Calm' is the opposite of windy: it means the air is still.
'Hot' is a temperature, not a description of moving air.
